messages.content: Write a COBOL Hello World program

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. HELLO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'HELLO WORLD'.
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL to read a sequential file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READSEQ.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INPUT-FILE.
       01 INPUT-RECORD        PIC X(80).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FILE-STATUS      PIC XX.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC 9 VALUE 0.
          88 END-OF-FILE      VALUE 1.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ INPUT-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       DISPLAY INPUT-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INPUT-FILE
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with WORKING-STORAGE variables

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VARSAMPLE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME             PIC X(30).
       01 WS-AGE              PIC 99.
       01 WS-SALARY           PIC 9(7)V99.
       01 WS-EDIT-SALARY      PIC $ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
       01 WS-DATE.
          05 WS-YEAR          PIC 9(4).
          05 WS-MONTH         PIC 99.
          05 WS-DAY           PIC 99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'JOHN DOE' TO WS-NAME
           MOVE 35 TO WS-AGE
           MOVE 75000.50 TO WS-SALARY
           MOVE WS-SALARY TO WS-EDIT-SALARY
           DISPLAY 'NAME: ' WS-NAME
           DISPLAY 'AGE: ' WS-AGE
           DISPLAY 'SALARY: ' WS-EDIT-SALARY
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with EVALUATE statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EVALEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-GRADE            PIC X.
       01 WS-RESULT           PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'B' TO WS-GRADE
           EVALUATE WS-GRADE
               WHEN 'A'
                   MOVE 'EXCELLENT' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'B'
                   MOVE 'GOOD' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'C'
                   MOVE 'AVERAGE' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'D'
                   MOVE 'BELOW AVERAGE' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'F'
                   MOVE 'FAILING' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'INVALID GRADE' TO WS-RESULT
           END-EVALUATE
           DISPLAY 'RESULT: ' WS-RESULT
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with PERFORM VARYING loop

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LOOPEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-INDEX            PIC 99.
       01 WS-TOTAL            PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-INDEX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-INDEX > 10
               ADD WS-INDEX TO WS-TOTAL
               DISPLAY 'INDEX: ' WS-INDEX ' TOTAL: ' WS-TOTAL
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY 'FINAL TOTAL: ' WS-TOTAL
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with STRING statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. STREXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FIRST-NAME       PIC X(10) VALUE 'JOHN'.
       01 WS-LAST-NAME        PIC X(10) VALUE 'DOE'.
       01 WS-FULL-NAME        PIC X(25).
       01 WS-POINTER          PIC 99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POINTER
           STRING WS-FIRST-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE
                  ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  WS-LAST-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE
               INTO WS-FULL-NAME
               WITH POINTER WS-POINTER
           END-STRING
           DISPLAY 'FULL NAME: ' WS-FULL-NAME
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with UNSTRING statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. UNSTEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-INPUT-STRING     PIC X(30) VALUE 'JOHN,DOE,35'.
       01 WS-FIRST-NAME       PIC X(10).
       01 WS-LAST-NAME        PIC X(10).
       01 WS-AGE              PIC X(5).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           UNSTRING WS-INPUT-STRING
               DELIMITED BY ','
               INTO WS-FIRST-NAME
                    WS-LAST-NAME
                    WS-AGE
           END-UNSTRING
           DISPLAY 'FIRST: ' WS-FIRST-NAME
           DISPLAY 'LAST: ' WS-LAST-NAME
           DISPLAY 'AGE: ' WS-AGE
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with INSPECT statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INSPEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STRING           PIC X(20) VALUE 'HELLO WORLD'.
       01 WS-COUNT            PIC 99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           INSPECT WS-STRING
               TALLYING WS-COUNT FOR ALL 'L'
           DISPLAY 'COUNT OF L: ' WS-COUNT
           INSPECT WS-STRING
               REPLACING ALL 'L' BY 'X'
           DISPLAY 'REPLACED: ' WS-STRING
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with OCCURS table

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TABLEEXM.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TABLE.
          05 WS-ITEM OCCURS 10 TIMES.
             10 WS-NAME       PIC X(20).
             10 WS-VALUE      PIC 9(5)V99.
       01 WS-INDEX            PIC 99.
       01 WS-TOTAL            PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-INDEX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-INDEX > 10
               MOVE 'ITEM' TO WS-NAME(WS-INDEX)
               MOVE WS-INDEX TO WS-VALUE(WS-INDEX)
               ADD WS-VALUE(WS-INDEX) TO WS-TOTAL
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY 'TOTAL: ' WS-TOTAL
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with SEARCH statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SRCHEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TABLE.
          05 WS-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-IDX.
             10 WS-CODE       PIC X(3).
             10 WS-DESC       PIC X(20).
       01 WS-SEARCH-CODE      PIC X(3).
       01 WS-FOUND-FLAG       PIC 9 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'A01' TO WS-CODE(1)
           MOVE 'FIRST ITEM' TO WS-DESC(1)
           MOVE 'B02' TO WS-CODE(2)
           MOVE 'SECOND ITEM' TO WS-DESC(2)
           MOVE 'C03' TO WS-CODE(3)
           MOVE 'THIRD ITEM' TO WS-DESC(3)
           MOVE 'B02' TO WS-SEARCH-CODE
           SET WS-IDX TO 1
           SEARCH WS-ENTRY
               AT END
                   DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND'
               WHEN WS-CODE(WS-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-CODE
                   DISPLAY 'FOUND: ' WS-DESC(WS-IDX)
           END-SEARCH
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL to call a subprogram

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MAINPROG.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-PARAM1           PIC 9(5) VALUE 100.
       01 WS-PARAM2           PIC 9(5) VALUE 200.
       01 WS-RESULT           PIC 9(6).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'CALLING SUBPROGRAM'
           CALL 'SUBPROG' USING WS-PARAM1
                                WS-PARAM2
                                WS-RESULT
           DISPLAY 'RESULT: ' WS-RESULT
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL subprogram with LINKAGE SECTION

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SUBPROG.
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01 LS-PARAM1           PIC 9(5).
       01 LS-PARAM2           PIC 9(5).
       01 LS-RESULT           PIC 9(6).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-PARAM1
                                LS-PARAM2
                                LS-RESULT.
           ADD LS-PARAM1 TO LS-PARAM2
               GIVING LS-RESULT
           GOBACK.
Write COBOL with 88 level condition names

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COND88.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STATUS           PIC X.
          88 STATUS-ACTIVE    VALUE 'A'.
          88 STATUS-INACTIVE  VALUE 'I'.
          88 STATUS-PENDING   VALUE 'P'.
          88 STATUS-VALID     VALUE 'A' 'I' 'P'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'A' TO WS-STATUS
           IF STATUS-ACTIVE
               DISPLAY 'RECORD IS ACTIVE'
           END-IF
           IF STATUS-VALID
               DISPLAY 'STATUS IS VALID'
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL to read VSAM KSDS file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READVSAM.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT VSAM-FILE ASSIGN TO VSAMFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
               ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
               RECORD KEY IS VS-KEY
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD VSAM-FILE.
       01 VSAM-RECORD.
          05 VS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 VS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FILE-STATUS      PIC XX.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT VSAM-FILE
           MOVE '0000000001' TO VS-KEY
           READ VSAM-FILE
               INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'RECORD NOT FOUND'
               NOT INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'DATA: ' VS-DATA
           END-READ
           CLOSE VSAM-FILE
           STOP RUN.
Write COBOL with COMPUTE statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COMPUTE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM1             PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 100.50.
       01 WS-NUM2             PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 25.25.
       01 WS-RESULT           PIC 9(7)V99.
       01 WS-PERCENTAGE       PIC 9(3)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           COMPUTE WS-RESULT = WS-NUM1 + WS-NUM2
           DISPLAY 'SUM: ' WS-RESULT
           COMPUTE WS-RESULT = WS-NUM1 * WS-NUM2
           DISPLAY 'PRODUCT: ' WS-RESULT
           COMPUTE WS-PERCENTAGE = 
               (WS-NUM2 / WS-NUM1) * 100
           DISPLAY 'PERCENTAGE: ' WS-PERCENTAGE
           STOP RUN.
